notes.title: Sanguine - Steam Deck compatibility
notes.notes:
[p]We’re excited to announce that [b]Sanguine is now fully compatible with the Steam Deck![/b][/p][p]That means you can take the nightmare of [b]Craven Oaks[/b] anywhere — whether it’s curled up in the dark at home or on the go, you can experience every scare, puzzle, and fight for survival on Valve’s handheld.[/p][h3]What this means for players:[/h3][list][*][p][b]Optimized Controls[/b] → Both Classic (fixed camera) and Modern (third-person) modes have been tested and tuned for Deck controls.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Smooth Performance[/b] → Low-poly PSX visuals + optimizations ensure stable framerates for a seamless horror experience.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Portable Survival Horror[/b] → Manage resources, uncover secrets, and survive the Bloods wherever you are.[/p][/*][/list][p]We’ve been eager to bring [i]Sanguine[/i] to as many players as possible, and the Steam Deck makes it easier than ever to jump into the demo and wishlist ahead of Early Access this October.[/p][p]Thank you for all the feedback and support — it’s helping shape [i]Sanguine[/i] every step of the way.[/p][p]🩸 [b]Play the Demo Now (Free):[/b]
[/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2825080/Sanguine/"][/dynamiclink]Thank you~[/p][p]– Ryan
[/p]

This patch contains a bunch of new features including Localization support, Character Select & Choose your path. Along with a few updates, improvements and fixes.

[h2]Alpha 1.0.7 Patch Notes:[/h2]

[h3]Localization Support added![/h3]
[list]
[*] There is now localization support for French, German and Spanish. You can change your language in the options menu.
[*] There are still a few things that need to be localized such as the intro video and a few images.
[*] I'm intending to release additional locals with the full release of the game. Right now I'm expecting to do at least Japanese and likely Russian. If there's a language you'd like to see, let me know!
[*] Choose your path is now implemented!
[*] After selecting your character you'll be prompted with an option to play the game in either the Classic or Modern mode.
[*] Classic features the fixed camera angles and tank style gameplay.
[*] Modern features the camera over the players shoulder, in third person.
[*] This selection is final until you start a new game! Play both options if you'd like~
[*] Character select screen is now implemented!
[*] When selecting new game, you'll now see a little backstory about the characters that you'll be able to play.
[*] The demo is locked to only allowing you to play Kris
[/list]

[h3]New features:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Added saved data encryption
[*] Added sound effect for combining the lighter and lighter fluid
[*] Added new music for the end game ranking screen
[*] Added the ability to stack items in the players storage box
[*] Added new medical crate container
[*] Added a few new cutscenes in the Diner location
[*] Updated a few POI's in the Forest location
[*] Added new hurt sound effects for the Corpse blood, Fast Corpse blood and Large corpse blood
[*] They'll play at random rather than hearing the same sound over and over
[/list]

[h3]Bug Fixes & Optimizations:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed a few lights not being properly lit throughout the world
[*] Updated the TV/VHS player to automatically accept the VHS tape and remove it from your inventory
[*] Added specific 3rd person tutorial document
[*] Fixed issue that could occur when quitting the game
[*] Fixed settings reverting correctly when not applied
[*] Lowered SFX volume of breaking crates
[*] Fixed issue with the 3rd person game mode mouse state not being locked at all times
[*] Fixed a few collision errors
[*] Fixed a crash that could sometimes happen in the gas station caved in area
[*] Updated several text fields to auto size based on localization size
[*] Reduced the file size of several textures
[*] Updated the HP tutorial document
[*] Optimized the Glock19's accuracy to the direction it's being pointed
[/list]

notes.title: Sanguine Demo
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44970004/976136071cb474854e6e6e962236b6b38ebbee20.png[/img]
[h1]Alpha 1.0.3 Patch Notes[/h1]
The demo has reached an alpha state! While there's still much to do and improve, I deeply appreciate everyone who has provided feedback and wishlisted the game—your support means a lot. This patch includes numerous fixes and major updates for the Sanguine demo, introducing a brand-new end game ranking system, extensive Main Menu and UI enhancements, significant map improvements, audio reworks, and much more.

[b]Note:[/b] It is highly recommended to create a new save.

[h2]Key Updates:[/h2]

[h3]End Game Ranking System[/h3]
[list]
[*] Introduced a new end game ranking system with seven different ranks to achieve.
[*] Ranks are determined by:
[*] Time taken to complete the demo.
[*] Number of saves used.
[*] Rankings will appear upon completing the demo.
[/list]

[h3]Main Menu[/h3]
[list]
[*] Added a new 3D background for the main menu.
[*] Adjusted button locations and highlights for improved navigation.
[*] Added a Credits button to watch the credits video.
[*] Fixed minor navigational bugs.
[*] Added new menu sound effects (SFX).
[*] Increased save file capacity.
[*] Updated save data font for better readability.
[*] Rolled back previous audio settings changes; it is recommended to keep audio at the default value of '0.'
[*] Enabled the ability to pause the intro car crash cutscene using Esc (keyboard) or Start (gamepad).
[/list]

[h3]UI[/h3]
[list]
[*] Updated UI legend icons for keyboard users.
[*] Added keyboard/gamepad detection for dialogue screens.
[*] Improved new player experience dialogs and added a new tutorial for sprinting.
[*] Enhanced the inventory UI:
[*] Locked slots are now more visible.
[*] Inventory dynamically adjusts when expanded.
[*] Adjusted legend locations across all UI menus.
[*] Updated the pause menu layout for key bindings.
[*] Added a "Switch UI Layout" option in the pause menu, toggling between keyboard and gamepad layouts.
[*] Updated document icons in the Files menu.
[*] Added a damage feedback UI to show when the player takes damage.
[*] Reworked the pickup text UI for better clarity.
[/list]

[h3]Map Improvements[/h3]
[list]
[*] The map now dynamically updates based on player interactions with the world:
[*] Icons and text appear and persist after interactions.
[*] Default state has the legend hidden.
[*] Added a Legend toggle:
[*] Click (mouse), Q (keyboard), or X (gamepad).
[*] Refined UI layout for improved clarity.
[/list]

[h3]Audio[/h3]
[list]
[*] Reworked in-world audio to reflect what the character hears.
[*] Added new surface SFX for various materials.
[*] Enhanced and added multiple SFX cues for immersion.
[*] Introduced:
[*] Audio for Officer John and the character in the diner bathroom.
[*] Dynamic world SFX.
[*] Audio for swinging the kitchen knife.
[*] A new song for the Main Street area.
[*] Fixed various audio bugs.
[/list]

[h3]Content Updates[/h3]
[list]
[*] Added a new credits video, custom music to come soon.
[*] Added a new cutscene and slightly extended the demo.
[*] Updated several existing cutscenes:
[*] The corpse blood encounter.
[*] The truck bed corpse blood scene.
[*] Added:
[*] New areas to explore and interact with.
[*] Footstep visual effects for surfaces like water and dirt.
[*] A small cutscene introducing the mutated corpse blood.
[*] New decals for environmental detail.
[*] Balanced health pools for better gameplay experience.
[*] Enhanced various models:
[*] Officer John’s model.
[*] The first officer statue and matching doll color.
[*] Updated environmental features:
[*] Improved lighting across the world.
[*] Added leaky pipe outside the diner to showcase water physics.
[*] Introduced new animations for actions like reaching high objects.
[*] Updated newspaper visuals and text.
[*] Refined Steam achievements and their icons.
[*] Added a new model for the AltRan main gate.
[/list]

[h3]Document Updates[/h3]
[list]
[*] Rewritten and refined the text for nearly all found documents.
[*] Updated the first tutorial document.
[*] Moved the map tutorial document to the forest.
[*] Added a new tutorial document in the shack near the mobile homes.
[/list]

[h3]Bug Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Resolved an issue where the first frame of the initial cutscene would flash.
[*] Fixed multiple collision issues.
[*] Addressed mouse state issues.
[*] Fixed disappearing Officer trunk key.
[*] Corrected long text running off the item examination window.
[*] Resolved inventory issues with multiple items being selected simultaneously.
[*] Fixed storage not updating after inventory expansion.
[*] Fixed jittery rotation bug.
[*] Corrected shot attack range and inconsistent headshot registration.
[/list]

Thank you for playing and supporting the Sanguine demo. Your feedback is invaluable—stay tuned for more updates!
